difficulty_reason: Sensitive or restricted user-data scopes can require verification; restricted-scope use may also require an independent security assessment.

time_estimate.worst_case: Several weeks or more (restricted scopes; Google says this can potentially take several weeks)

effort: Create a Google Cloud project and OAuth consent configuration, select the minimum scopes, prepare app and privacy information, and submit verification when required. Restricted scopes that access data through a server can add a third-party security assessment.
prerequisites: Google Cloud project and OAuth consent configuration.
Public-facing privacy and app details may be needed for verification; confirm the current checklist in the console.
Restricted scopes may require additional review and, for server access to restricted data, a security assessment.

steps.title: Create a Cloud project and OAuth client
steps.instruction: Create or select a project, configure the consent screen, and choose the application type. Keep the client secret private.

steps.title: Choose the minimum scopes
steps.instruction: Check the scope classification and API method requirements. Prefer less sensitive scopes when they meet the use case.

steps.title: Configure redirect URIs
steps.instruction: Set the correct OAuth client type and exact redirect URI for the application flow; verify current restrictions in the console.

steps.title: Submit verification if required
steps.instruction: Follow the console's verification checklist. Restricted scopes can require additional documentation and potentially a security assessment.

approval.review_needed: Public apps using sensitive or restricted scopes need verification unless an exception applies. Exact requirements depend on scopes and use.
approval.triggers: Scope classification, user type, publishing status, data use, and applicable exceptions affect whether verification is required.
approval.checks: Google's published guidance requires review for sensitive/restricted scopes; consult current verification checklist for branding, privacy, and scope-specific details.
approval.slow_factors: Restricted-scope verification may take several weeks; Google says brand verification typically takes 2–3 business days when branding information changed since the last approved consent screen verification.

blockers.problem: A requested scope is sensitive or restricted
blockers.fix: Reduce scopes where possible. Otherwise prepare verification materials and check whether a security assessment applies.

blockers.problem: App remains in testing or shows an unverified warning
blockers.fix: Review publishing status, user type, and scope requirements in the Cloud console; submit the applicable verification request.

scopes.name: Sensitive scopes
scopes.why: Google requires review for sensitive scopes; public apps using scopes accessing user data must complete verification.

scopes.name: Restricted scopes
scopes.why: Require verification unless an exception applies; server access to restricted data may require an annual independent security assessment.

redirect_rules: Google OAuth client types have flow-specific redirect rules. Confirm the selected client type and exact URI constraints in the current official OAuth documentation and console; this guide does not generalize rules across types.
agent_handoff: An agent can compare documented scopes, draft a checklist, and prepare descriptions. A human must access Cloud Console, supply business and privacy details, verify ownership, manage credentials, and complete verification or security assessment submissions.
next_action: List the exact Google API methods and minimum scopes your product needs, then check each scope's classification before building the consent screen.

evidence.claim: Sensitive scopes require review; public apps accessing user data must complete verification.
evidence.label: SOURCED

evidence.claim: Restricted scopes may require a security assessment; server-side access to restricted data requires annual assessment by a Google-approved third party.
evidence.label: SOURCED

evidence.claim: Google states restricted-scope verification can potentially take several weeks; brand verification typically takes 2–3 business days when branding changed.
evidence.label: SOURCED
